author: Axiom III
title: CES infra: Endurance panels + summary exporters (deep/shallow)
abstract: Implements exporters for CES endurance panels (deep/shallow) and an endurance summary JSON to compute monotonicity, slope, and percent drop.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from meta.sas.tools.export_endurance_panel import export_panel
from meta.sas.tools.export_endurance_summary import export as export_summary

# Dry-run exporters (will produce empty/partial outputs until CES beacons exist)
p_deep = export_panel(agent='Zephyr IV', mode='deep',
                      dir_path='storage/shared/meta/sas/beacons',
                      out_path='storage/shared/meta/sas/dashboard/endurance_deep_zephyr_iv.json')
p_shal = export_panel(agent='Zephyr IV', mode='shallow',
                      dir_path='storage/shared/meta/sas/beacons',
                      out_path='storage/shared/meta/sas/dashboard/endurance_shallow_zephyr_iv.json')
summ = export_summary(agent='Zephyr IV',
                      dir_path='storage/shared/meta/sas/beacons',
                      out_path='storage/shared/meta/sas/derived/endurance_summary.json')
print(json.dumps({"endurance_deep_panel": p_deep, "endurance_shallow_panel": p_shal, "summary": summ}, indent=2))
